requirements.statement: A user can sign up and sign in securely so their to-do items are tied to their own account and stay private

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is prompted to sign in before reaching the to-do list
After signing in, the user reaches their own to-do list
A signed-in user cannot see another user's to-do items

requirements.statement: A user can create a to-do item with a title and description

criteria.must: Submitting the new to-do form with a title creates a to-do item
A created to-do item stores the description entered
Submitting the new to-do form without a title is rejected

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of to-do items, seeing what is pending and what is done

criteria.must: The to-do list shows every to-do item the user has created
The to-do list distinguishes pending items from completed items

requirements.statement: A user can edit a to-do item's title or description

criteria.must: Editing a to-do item's title persists the new title
Editing a to-do item's description persists the new description

requirements.statement: A user can mark a to-do item as complete or incomplete to track progress

criteria.must: Marking a pending to-do item complete updates its status to done
Marking a completed to-do item incomplete updates its status back to pending

requirements.statement: A user can delete a to-do item they no longer need

criteria.must: Deleting a to-do item removes it from the user's list

requirements.statement: A user's to-do items persist across sessions and devices

criteria.must: A to-do item created in one session is still present after signing out and signing back in
